column1: Use the email on your Pinterest account and a Pinterest password. Google sign-in doesn't work with stock Google Play services, because this patched app is signed with a different key. Pinterest no longer offers Facebook login. The Fix push notifications patch, on by default, lets this app sign up for push notifications.

Masuk dengan Google tidak berfungsi dengan layanan Google Play biasa, karena aplikasi yang ditambal ini ditandatangani dengan kunci yang berbeda. Pinterest tidak lagi menawarkan login Facebook. Patch "Perbaiki notifikasi push", yang aktif secara default, memungkinkan aplikasi ini mendaftar untuk notifikasi push.

column1: If you joined through Google or don't know your Pinterest password, choose Forgot your password on Pinterest's login page. Enter the email already linked to that account, then use the reset link sent to your email to set a Pinterest password. It's separate from your Google password. You don't need to unlink Google.

column1: # context: a Feed switch under Muted words, from the Keep Home feed patch. When it's on, the Home feed doesn't load new pins by itself when the person comes back to the app or to the Home tab, so the pins they were looking at stay put. Pulling down on Home still loads new ones. The title is also the patch's name in the build report and in the settings import preview
Keep Home feed
column2: Pertahankan beranda

column1: Home keeps the pins you were looking at when you come back to Pinterest or to the Home tab. Pull down on Home to load new pins.
column2: Beranda tetap menampilkan pin yang sedang Anda lihat saat Anda kembali ke Pinterest atau ke tab Beranda. Tarik ke bawah di Beranda untuk memuat pin baru.

column1: # context: an Interface switch under Original images, from the Show posted date patch. When it's on, the day a pin was posted shows in small text under the pin's title when the pin is opened. The title is also the patch's name in the build report and in the settings import preview. In Posted %1$s, %1$s is the date written the phone's way, such as Oct 12, 2026
Show posted date
column2: Tampilkan tanggal posting

column1: Shows the day a pin was posted under its title. It shows on the next pin you open.
column2: Menampilkan tanggal pin diposting di bawah judulnya. Tanggal muncul di pin berikutnya yang Anda buka.

column2: Diposting %1$s

column1: # context: Download pins switches that tie a pin's download to its save
Save pins you download
column2: Simpan pin yang diunduh

column1: Downloading a pin from its menu also saves it to your profile, unless it's saved already. Grid and board downloads aren't saved. Needs Download pins on.
column2: Mengunduh pin dari menunya juga menyimpannya ke profil Anda, kecuali sudah disimpan. Unduhan dari kisi dan papan tidak disimpan. Unduh Pin harus aktif.

column1: Saving a pin also downloads it, from any screen. Needs Download pins on.
column2: Menyimpan pin juga mengunduhnya, dari layar mana pun. Unduh Pin harus aktif.

column1: # context: an Interface switch that removes Pinterest's AI Assistant from the search page, boards and pins; "Assistant" is that feature's name
Hide Assistant
column2: Sembunyikan Asisten

column1: Takes Pinterest's AI Assistant out of search, boards and pins. Search works as usual. The change shows the next time the screen updates.
column2: Menghapus Asisten AI Pinterest dari pencarian, papan, dan pin. Pencarian tetap berfungsi seperti biasa. Perubahan terlihat saat layar diperbarui berikutnya.

column1: # context: a Feed switch from the Filter feed patch. It takes pins the person has already saved to a board out of their home feed only; boards and search still show them. The title is also the name of that part of the patch in the build report.
Hide pins you've already saved
column2: Sembunyikan pin yang sudah disimpan

column1: Takes pins you've saved out of your home feed. Your boards and search still show them.
column2: Menghapus pin yang sudah Anda simpan dari beranda. Papan dan pencarian Anda tetap menampilkannya.
